assertions.title: User cannot see another user's categories
assertions.reason: User-scoped category listing enforced for both users via X-User-Id.

steps.action: POST /api/categories as User A and User B with unique names
steps.expected: Both creates return 201 and create separate category IDs.
steps.observed: User A status 201 (id 946), User B status 201 (id 947).

steps.expected: Contains User A category and excludes User B category.
Contains User B category and excludes User A category.

assertions.title: User cannot see another user's transactions
assertions.reason: Transaction lists are user-scoped and direct cross-user transaction-id update attempt is denied with 404.

steps.action: POST /api/transactions as User A and User B using each user's own category
steps.expected: Both creates return 201 with separate transaction IDs.
steps.observed: User A status 201 (id 414), User B status 201 (id 415).

steps.action: GET /api/transactions as User A and User B
steps.expected: Each user sees only own transaction(s).
steps.observed: User A status 200 own visible=True other hidden=True; User B status 200 own visible=True other hidden=True.

steps.action: PUT /api/transactions/414 as User B (direct ID access attempt)
steps.observed: Status 404 with body Transaction not found.

assertions.title: Data isolation across all areas
assertions.reason: Could verify categories and transactions isolation, but budget/dashboard API surface required by this cross-area assertion is blocked by persistent 500 responses for both users.

steps.action: GET /api/categories and GET /api/transactions for User A and User B
steps.expected: All list endpoints return only each user's own data.
steps.observed: Categories and transactions isolation checks passed for both users.

steps.action: GET /api/budgets?year=2026&month=3 for User A and User B
steps.expected: Endpoint returns user-scoped budget data or empty state response.
steps.observed: User A status 500, User B status 500, body: {"error":"An unexpected error occurred"}.

steps.action: GET /api/dashboard?year=2026&month=3 for User A and User B
steps.expected: Endpoint returns user-scoped dashboard aggregate data.
steps.observed: User A status 500, User B status 500, body: {"error":"An unexpected error occurred"}.

steps.action: Retry budget/dashboard requests 3 times per endpoint per user
steps.expected: Transient failure clears and endpoints become testable.
steps.observed: All retries remained 500 for both users and both endpoints.

assertions.issues: Budget/dashboard endpoints return 500 for both users, preventing full cross-area data isolation verification.

blockers.description: Cross-area budget endpoints are not testable due to persistent 500 responses on /api/budgets and /api/dashboard for both users.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried each endpoint 3 times for User A and User B; all responses remained HTTP 500 with {"error":"An unexpected error occurred"}.

summary: Tested 3 assertions: 2 passed (VAL-CAT-008, VAL-TXN-013), 0 failed, 1 blocked (VAL-CROSS-007 due budget/dashboard 500 responses).
